call_points.text: Credit cost is guided to remain up to 0.75% on a quarter-on-quarter basis through next year.
Management expects RoA to remain above 1% going forward, supported by loan mix and repricing.
Recoveries from written-off accounts are expected to exceed ₹2,500 Cr in FY27.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterated prior ₹2,200-2,500 Cr guidance at ₹2,500+ Cr

call_points.text: 61% of loan book is linked to external benchmarks, supporting yields and NIMs in a rising rate cycle.
FY27 business growth guided at 14-15%; achieved 20.54% in Q2
Advances growth guided at 14-16%; Q2 came in at 29.83%
CASA guided at 48% (+/-1%); Q2 was 44.65%, a miss
NIM guided above 3%; Q2 NIM was 3.01%
Cost to income guided below 56%; Q2 was 58.95%
Credit cost guided up to 0.75% annualised; Q2 was 0.53%
Standard asset provisions jumped to ₹379 Cr from ₹30 Cr YoY
Deposit growth guided at 11-12% and advances at 14-16% for FY27, reiterated from earlier market guidance.
Yield on advances expected to rise from 7.89% to 8% by March 2027, helped by gold loan and SHG.
ECL: ₹1,525 Cr of Stage 1 and 2 provisions made against a ₹4,500-5,000 Cr total requirement; shift from 1 April 2027.
FCNR(B) mobilisation of USD8.4 million so far, targeting USD400 million by September 2026.
Corporate credit grew 46.52% to ₹1,12,770 Cr, which the MD attributed to a low base; focus areas are renewables, data centres and HAM.
Gold loan book is ₹36,000 Cr; dedicated gold loan and SHG divisions set up, heads reporting to an Executive Director.
ECLGS 5.0: 34,824 applications sanctioned for ₹4,646 Cr, guarantees issued for ₹4,353 Cr, disbursed ₹3,693 Cr in 27,567 accounts.
FY27 IT budget: ₹1,442 Cr capital and ₹1,276 Cr revenue spend.
Q4 slippages rose to ₹1,301 Cr from about ₹800 Cr a quarter, on MSME technical and agriculture accounts.
Total dividend declared for FY26 is 12%, ₹1.20 per equity share, including three quarterly interim dividends.
